title: Ringo Starr and his All-Starr Band live: Crocus City Hall, Moscow | 2011
content:
Ringo Starr and his All-Starr Band performed at the Crocus City Hall in Moscow, Russia, on 6 June 2011.

It was the second show of the 11th All-Starr Band’s tour of Europe and South America, which lasted for 39 dates between June and November 2011.

The 11th All-Starr Band

  • Ringo Starr: vocals, drums, percussion
  • Wally Palmar: vocals, guitar, harmonica
  • Rick Derringer: vocals, guitar
  • Edgar Winter: vocals, keyboards, saxophone
  • Gary Wright: vocals, keyboards
  • Richard Page: vocals, bass guitar
  • Gregg Bissonette: vocals, drums
